behaviors.assignee-options-counts: Opening the Assignee filter shows Anyone, each person, and Unassigned with task counts.
behaviors.search-assignees: Searching the Assignee dropdown narrows its choices to matching people.
behaviors.filter-by-person: Selecting Priya Shah shows only her assigned tasks and updates the task summary.
behaviors.filter-unassigned: Selecting Unassigned shows only tasks without an assignee.
behaviors.empty-assignee-state: Selecting Ana Lima shows an empty state saying nothing is assigned to her yet, with a Clear filters control.
behaviors.clear-filters: Clear filters resets both Status and Assignee selections and restores the full task list.

history.notes: The dropdown popup is rendered outside the toolbar, so option and count checks use the open popup. Toolbar locators are used for the filter controls and summary.
